evals.prompt: Add bloom and an outline to our existing Three.js scene, keep them sharp after resize, and give low-end devices a cheaper path.
evals.expected_output: An EffectComposer plan with explicit pass order, composer/renderer resize synchronization, independent toggles, and measured quality tiers.
assertions: Uses composer rendering rather than double-rendering the same final canvas
Keeps camera, renderer, and composer dimensions synchronized on resize
Treats bloom/outline cost as a target-device budget decision

evals.prompt: Displace a mesh's vertices with simplex noise and expose a time uniform.
evals.expected_output: Routes custom vertex GLSL to threejs-shaders rather than full-screen post-processing.
assertions: Names threejs-shaders as the primary owner
Distinguishes mesh-space shader work from a screen-space pass
